scope: Authenticated Jeeves game-learning workspaces compose existing historical game-engine, simulation, ingestion, learning and product owners; no new service, external provider or runtime root

dependencies.simulation: Existing Jeeves legacy/3D/modern runtime families and explicitly registered existing ROM execution implementations only
dependencies.learning: Existing learning/evaluation principles: measured local transitions, held-out evaluation, immutable candidate lineage; no production mutation
dependencies.ingestion: Existing Dragon scrape/knowledge records are untrusted sources with owner/tenant/rights scope; no feature-owned external provider
dependencies.persistence: Existing CORE_DB Mongo application authority stores project/source/session/job revisions and policy snapshots
dependencies.product: Existing authenticated endpoint resolver and backend API; no browser-owned game or policy authority
dependencies.experimental_rom: machine/ai_game_rom_runtime.json; explicitly bounded Game Boy profile only, no universal emulation claim
dependencies.dragon: Existing current-main skeleton/ai/webcrawler native target/source builders, owner-scoped knowledge custody and practice records; no feature-owned scraping/provider

interfaces.catalogue: Truthful registered platform/engine profiles, exact action/observation capabilities and supported ingestion formats; reference simulation and full hardware emulation are distinct statuses
interfaces.sources: Bounded validated ROM/project/trace/text/Dragon evidence with digest, explicit provenance and retained rights; unknown unsupported formats remain unavailable
interfaces.editor: Server-owned project files and per-platform configuration edits with exact expected revision, canonical path/bounds and immutable history
interfaces.simulation: Bounded actual reset/step/action/observation/snapshot/restore through registered local runtime adapters; no fabricated frames or universal console compatibility
interfaces.training: Actual bounded local policy updates from measured transitions, deterministic seeds, durable policy/episode cursor, cancellation and truthful failure/recovery status
interfaces.evaluation: Executed paired candidate/baseline held-out episodes remain candidate evidence; no automatic production promotion
interfaces.generation: Seeded original compatible game projects from grounded metadata and learned policy lineage; source ROM assets/code are not copied into outputs
interfaces.export: Authorized exact-version project bundle with truthful target/runtime/toolchain capability and bounded file content
interfaces.installed_emulators: Exact operator-approved native core/hash/platform/firmware/content identities, actual libretro C ABI in isolated bounded workers; unavailable/unimplemented hardware remains explicit
interfaces.human_play: One authenticated controller lease, sequenced bounded input, actual framebuffer, source/version fencing, pause/reset/stop and explicit recording consent
interfaces.live_training: Actual actor observations and sampled frame sequence with bounded viewing and no synthetic progress; independent worker instances 1..8 under resource limits
interfaces.human_learning: Measured authenticated input/observation/reward trace with exact source/environment and issuer lineage; explicit imitation/offline learning under current consent, not a claim of biological-human identity
interfaces.parallel_learning: Frozen policy per actor batch, process-isolated actual rollouts, deterministic assignments and central episode-atomic updates/resume/cancel; no shared mutable learner races
interfaces.native_console_build: Exact revision source/asset/project edit and operator-approved installed SDK/compiler plan, isolated worker commands, bounded logs and exact output hash; no source-only target declared compiled
interfaces.large_media: Immutable indexed 1 MiB chunks, streamed file SHA-256 and linked media verification, exact-source publication and private file-backed runtime binding
interfaces.target_console_editing: Typed exact-revision source/asset/map/scene/palette/controller project manifests, real native asset codecs and per-target hardware/toolchain limits; all canonical targets enumerated with unsupported operations explicit
interfaces.successor: Exactly one or three distinct source origins, current owner/rights or explicitly authored inspiration, measured/authored mechanic profiles, coherent original experience graph and original playable project with full provenance; no imported game code or assets copied
interfaces.portable_desktop: Exact original-source artifact packages for Windows PC, macOS and Linux; self-contained browser game in native cross-compiled launcher plus real native SDL2 builds where actual toolchains exist; binary format and build identity explicit
interfaces.successor_metrics: Actual bounded game rollouts/learning/runtime measurements and declared before-after constraints; no invented original-game superiority or subjective studio-grade claim

failure: Invalid source, unavailable emulator, unsupported hardware instruction/mapper, mismatched project revision, foreign source/policy identity, exhausted resources and cancelled/expired jobs fail explicitly; generic historical simulations never establish hardware compatibility; native worker crashes/timeouts, absent ABI/firmware/toolchain or required sandbox, stale input controller, missing current demonstration consent and partial actor batches fail explicitly
rollback: Keep source/project/policy revisions and restore the prior approved project or policy; disabling this additive UI/API does not change existing provider routing or erase canonical history
verification: User-directed implementation, actual productive builds/play/learning and source validation; no automated tests added or run. Foreign hardware execution, commercial-game superiority, studio qualification and production closure require their own evidence.
implementation_scope: Actual existing coded owners, bounded local learning and studio workflow; no complete all-game/hardware compatibility or studio qualification claim

continuation.scope: Playable installed-core emulation, live viewer/control, authenticated human demonstrations, parallel measured actor learning and isolated native console builds

two_hour_continuation.scope: Expand real console emulation and target-aware original source/asset/map/controller editors; synthesize an original one- or three-source successor; ship playable PC/macOS/Linux packages and actual build/learning/performance evidence
two_hour_continuation.user_example: Adventure inspired by Zelda, fishing inspired by Pokemon, farming inspired by Harvest Moon in a large original 2026-oriented world
two_hour_continuation.evidence_rule: Installed core/static toolchain metadata is not compatibility proof; authored inspiration is not measured ROM digestion; outperforming originals requires identified metrics and actual comparative workloads
two_hour_continuation.latest_user_priority: Build the studio app rather than more sample games: executable scoped Jeeves/Dragon/adversarial improvement triangle, remembered lessons, advanced editors/builders/simulations and genuine progressive fidelity.
two_hour_continuation.app_tool_registration_fix: Existing dotted app/creator/shadow tool labels were invalid under canonical agent tool-name validation. Registered names now use provider-compatible underscores, with matching permission comparisons and exact mirrors. No new tool grants are created.

continued_studio_pass.scope: Close actual native edit/build/play and AI app-use integration; deepen advanced scene/animation/rule authoring and multiobjective retained-learning campaigns under existing owners

studio_engine_environment_extension.catalog: Existing /game-learning catalog exposes studio_engines without mixing native emulators with reference engines.
studio_engine_environment_extension.source: Projects may admit game/studio/session.json; it is typed/seed-bound and selected only when no competing generated/editor/successor authoritative source exists.
studio_engine_environment_extension.request: Original editor ID becomes studio:<editor>; max episode replay length is capped to 128, including from existing application jobs.
studio_engine_environment_extension.training: Existing authenticated GameLearningWorkspace and StudioLearningCampaign routes can use GameEnvironmentRequest(kind='studio') and existing measured Q-learning, demonstration, and local rollout actors.
limitations: API/frontend access depends on project authoring support and exact-head execution validation
No native hardware pixels from authoring-only engines
No automatic live production transformer weight updates

studio_engine_corpus_training.workflow: Rights-cleared original studio gameplay produces independently replay-verified text examples, pinned by SHA256 and admitted as candidate-only training examples to the authentic SKELETON_OWN checkpoint-derived Jeeves optimizer; separately declared Pareto heldout is preserved.
studio_engine_corpus_training.boundaries: No new service/provider. No automatic training, model promotion or live serving-weight changes; operator initiates the pinned candidate with the checkpoint and attestation.
studio_engine_corpus_training.status_limit: No live checkpoint was accessed or neural optimizer executed during this GitHub-only authoring session; local tests and exact-head CI remain required.

studio_engine_project_creation.action: Existing authenticated create-project now accepts studio:<registered_engine> and creates pinned game/studio/session.json. Existing simulate/record/train routes use the exact same emulator-style episode transport.
